# listmonk_template (Data Source)

Looks up one listmonk template by `id` or by exact `name`, e.g. to use a template created in the UI or the built-in default.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "listmonk_template" "builtin" {
  name = "Default campaign template"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the template.
- `name` (String) Name of the template.

### Read-Only

- `body` (String) Template body.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default campaign template.
- `subject` (String) Subject of a `tx` template.
- `type` (String) `campaign`, `campaign_visual` or `tx`.
